crossRefs.note: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those…
Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.
They both made a covenant before Yahweh. Then David stayed in the woods, and Jonathan went to his house.
“He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they…
Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a…
“I have trodden the wine press alone. Of the peoples, no one was with me. Yes, I trod them in my anger and trampled…
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”
He who hates me, hates my Father also.
If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and…
Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.
He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.

translations.web: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
translations.bsb: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
translations.kjv: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
translations.asv: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
